craft_notes: Sthāyin: fire-denial (parallel denial-verse). Rows: row 2 (only-in/entering). Close: starts (prārambha — beginning as verb). Rejected: 'ignition' — killed: burning kept; 'inception' — killed: beginning kept.

lines: No burning-power of fire is separate — conceived so;
only in knowing-being, in entering, the beginning starts.
l4.sanskrit_cite: na vahner dāhikā śaktir vyatiriktā vibhāvyate | kevalaṃ jñānasattāyām prārambho 'yam praveśane

reads_against.argmap: Is fire's burning separate? → No separate burning power: entry itself begins it, in knowing-being alone.
c1_essence: Fire's burning not separate: entry begins it in knowing-being.
reads_against.c1_rasa: adbhuta settling toward śānta (wonder of the unspeakable)
